skill.name: email-sequence
skill.description: Create and optimize lifecycle email sequences, including welcome, nurture, onboarding, retention, billing, win-back, and campaign flows.
skill.summary: Build structured email sequences with triggers, timing, copy guidance, segmentation, and metrics.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All thirteen static detections are false positives from marketing language and markdown output examples in SKILL.md. content.value_statement: Email programs often fail because timing, goals, and copy are unclear. This skill helps create structured lifecycle sequences with clear triggers, messages, and metrics.
actual_capabilities: Designs welcome, lead nurture, onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign email sequences.
Recommends sequence length, timing, triggers, exit conditions, and CTA focus.
Drafts subject lines, preview text, email bodies, and call-to-action copy.
Provides segmentation, personalization, testing, and metric guidance.
Audits existing email programs against a lifecycle email checklist.
limitations: Does not send emails, connect to ESPs, or manage automation platforms.
Needs accurate product, audience, offer, and lifecycle details from the user.
Benchmarks are general guidance and should be validated with campaign data.
Does not replace legal review for consent, privacy, or unsubscribe requirements.

use_cases.title: Launch Welcome Flow
use_cases.description: Plan a welcome sequence with timing, subject lines, copy themes, and one clear action per email.

use_cases.title: Improve Trial Conversion
use_cases.description: Create onboarding and upgrade emails that guide trial users toward activation and paid conversion.

use_cases.title: Win Back Customers
use_cases.description: Build re-engagement or cancelled customer sequences with relevant offers, timing, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Welcome Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new list or product signup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5-email welcome sequence for [audience]. The product is [product]. The main goal is [goal]. Include timing, subject lines, preview text, body copy, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve copy, timing, and conversion focus.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this email sequence for [audience]. Identify weak goals, unclear CTAs, timing issues, and missing value. Then rewrite the weakest email and suggest three tests.

prompt_templates.title: Build Behavior-Based Onboarding
prompt_templates.scenario: Design lifecycle emails triggered by user actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an onboarding sequence for [product] based on these user behaviors: [behaviors]. Include triggers, exit conditions, segments, copy angles, and metrics for each email.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Segmented Lifecycle Program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across multiple customer stages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a lifecycle email map for [business]. Cover welcome, nurture, activation, retention, billing, and win-back stages. Define segments, triggers, message goals, and measurement priorities.

output_examples.input: Create a five-email welcome sequence for a B2B analytics trial.
output: Email 1 welcomes the user immediately and points to one setup step.
Email 2 delivers a quick win on day two with a clear product action.
Email 3 explains the main business value and links to a relevant example.
Email 4 handles a common objection with proof from a similar customer.
Email 5 invites the user to upgrade or book help before the trial ends.

output_examples.input: Audit a re-engagement sequence for inactive newsletter subscribers.
output: Clarify the audience segment by inactivity period and previous engagement.
Open with useful content before making an offer.
Use a final preference or opt-down email before removing inactive subscribers.
Track clicks, replies, unsubscribes, and recovered active subscribers.

output_examples.input: Plan emails for a failed payment recovery flow.
output: Send the first notice immediately with a direct update-payment link.
Follow with a helpful reminder that explains service impact clearly.
Use a final notice before access changes, with support contact details.
Measure recovery rate, support replies, and churn after failed payments.

best_practices: Define one primary goal and one CTA for every email.
Segment by lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent before writing copy.
Measure opens, clicks, conversions, unsubscribes, and revenue per sequence.
anti_patterns: Sending the same message to every subscriber regardless of behavior.
Asking for a sale before delivering value or context.
Adding multiple competing CTAs to a single email.

faq.question: What types of email sequences can this skill create?
faq.answer: It supports welcome, nurture, onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, promotional, and newsletter sequences.

faq.question: Can it write full email copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTA text, and sequence notes.

faq.question: Does it integrate with email platforms?
faq.answer: No. It creates strategy and copy, but it does not connect to ESPs or send messages.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide audience, product, offer, trigger, desired action, brand tone, constraints, and past performance data.

faq.question: Can it audit existing campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review sequence structure, timing, CTAs, subject lines, segmentation, and measurement gaps.

faq.question: Is the advice compliant with email law?
faq.answer: It includes general lifecycle guidance, but users should confirm consent, privacy, and unsubscribe rules with legal counsel.
